Find $\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}$ for the circle shown above." :question/worked-solution "Since our circle is centered at $(2,1)$ and has a radius of $2,$ its equation is given by

$$
(x-2)^{2}+(y-1)^{2}={2}^{2}\,⟹\,(x-2)^{2}+(y-1)^{2}=4.
$$

Now, to calculate $\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x},$ we use implicit differentiation:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}((x-2)^{2}+(y-1)^{2}) & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(4) \\ \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}((x-2)^{2})+\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}((y-1)^{2}) & =0 \\ 2(x-2)+2(y-1)\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =0 \\ 2(y-1)\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =-2(x-2) \\ \frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =-\frac{x-2}{y-1}\end{aligned}
$$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate :question/answer-fields ["b0263139-c8c5-505f-b0e2-da3711351949"] :db/ensure :question/validate} {:db/id "01090ad4-63b2-5233-bffe-b043f421a2e1" :answer/id #uuid "01090ad4-63b2-5233-bffe-b043f421a2e1" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "-\frac{x+\frac{7}{2}}{2(y+\frac{7}{2})}" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "52757574-b275-5ca4-8281-178bdf3acebe" :answer/id #uuid "52757574-b275-5ca4-8281-178bdf3acebe" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "-\frac{y+\frac{7}{2}}{x+\frac{7}{2}}" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "c015011f-bd7b-5f6b-ac3a-407f6bc8c925" :answer/id #uuid "c015011f-bd7b-5f6b-ac3a-407f6bc8c925" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "\frac{x+\frac{7}{2}}{y+\frac{7}{2}}" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "985622cd-15fa-553a-9f98-7bd854bfacb3" :answer/id #uuid "985622cd-15fa-553a-9f98-7bd854bfacb3" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "-\frac{x+\frac{7}{2}}{y+\frac{7}{2}}" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "5c687f3a-47f7-587b-9753-63ed8bc571a4" :answer/id #uuid "5c687f3a-47f7-587b-9753-63ed8bc571a4" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "-\frac{2(x+\frac{7}{2})}{y+\frac{7}{2}}" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "2d4ae89f-72cb-5f0d-9c04-4dd06ee4f34b" :answer-field/id #uuid "2d4ae89f-72cb-5f0d-9c04-4dd06ee4f34b" :answer-field/key "selection" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/radio :answer-field/choices ["01090ad4-63b2-5233-bffe-b043f421a2e1" "52757574-b275-5ca4-8281-178bdf3acebe" "c015011f-bd7b-5f6b-ac3a-407f6bc8c925" "985622cd-15fa-553a-9f98-7bd854bfacb3" "5c687f3a-47f7-587b-9753-63ed8bc571a4"] :answer-field/correct "985622cd-15fa-553a-9f98-7bd854bfacb3" :db/ensure :answer-field/validate} {:db/id "83cbdb9d-4c60-50a0-9ca5-3b0274718c06" :question/id #uuid "83cbdb9d-4c60-50a0-9ca5-3b0274718c06" :question/problem "![](images/a3/a335ec0ac7f4502b973f0ef444f8ff96f4bd630e4c2e957ef86e52f29776dfbc.png)

Find $\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}$ for the circle shown above." :question/worked-solution "Since our circle is centered at $(- \frac{7}{2},- \frac{7}{2})$ and has a radius of $\frac{3}{2},$ its equation is given by

$$
(x-(- \frac{7}{2}))^{2}+(y-(- \frac{7}{2}))^{2}={\frac{3}{2}}^{2}\,⟹\,(x+\frac{7}{2})^{2}+(y+\frac{7}{2})^{2}=\frac{9}{4}.
$$

Now, to calculate $\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x},$ we use implicit differentiation:
